title: Leaf Management
description: A server management mod featuring a resettable resource world, RTP system, and utility commands for streamlined gameplay.
body:
Leaf Management Mod is a lightweight server utility mod designed to simplify resource gathering and world management for Minecraft servers.

Built for Forge 1.18.2, this mod introduces a fully functional resource world system with tools for admins and players to easily navigate, reset, and manage it.

--------------------------------------------------------------
🌍 Resource World System
Dedicated resource world dimension

Easily teleport using: /leaf resource tp

Safe teleporting to terrain (no void spawns)
--------------------------------------------------------------
🎲 Random Teleport (RTP)

Teleport to a random location within the resource world: /leaf resource rtp

Automatically respects the world border
Ensures safe landing locations
--------------------------------------------------------------
🧱 World Border Control

Set the resource world border radius: /leaf resource border set <radius>

Keeps RTP and exploration contained
--------------------------------------------------------------
🔁 Resettable Resource World

Quickly reset the resource world: /leaf resource reset

Generates a new random seed each reset
Perfect for renewable mining, farming, and exploration
--------------------------------------------------------------
🏠 Return Home Command

Instantly return to the main world spawn: /leaf resource home
--------------------------------------------------------------
⚙️ Designed For Servers
Prevents overworld destruction by isolating resource gathering
Encourages fair gameplay and renewable environments
Simple command-based system no complex setup required
